div.span:
Lock State Vector:
• lockState ('LOCKED'|'UNLOCKING'|'UNLOCKED'|'RELOCKING'|'LOCKOUT'|'FAULT')
• doorReedOpen: boolean
• solenoidActive: boolean
• boltRetracted: boolean
• failureCounter: number
• lockoutEndTime: number | null
• lockoutDurationSeconds: number
• lockoutRepeatCount: number
• maxFailuresBeforeLockout: number
• unlockHoldSeconds: number
• activeGestureStep: StepEnum

Hardware & Link:
• esp32Online: boolean
• wifiRssi: number
• serviceSwitchEngaged: boolean
• sensors: SensorHealth (hx711, gyro, accel, fp)
• injectSensorFault: boolean

Attempts & Telemetry:
• attempts: AttemptRecord[]
• activeSessionFrames: TelemetryFrame[]
• isStreaming: boolean
• playbackSpeed: number

Owner Profile:
• ownerProfile: OwnerProfile (means, stds, tau, enrolled, trials)

Preferences & Alerts:
• language: 'en' | 'ar'
• theme: 'dark' | 'light'
• notifications: AppNotification[]
